The Patek Philippe Grand Complications Perpetual Calendar (5204R-011) manual wind watch, features a 40mm rose gold case surrounding a gray dial. Watch is secured on an olive-green Jean Rousseau alligator strap and an 18k rose gold Calatrava Cross deployant buckle. Functions include rattrapante chronograph, hours, minutes, seconds, date, day, day/night indicator, month, moon phase, perpetual calendar and year. This Patek Philippe watch also measures 14.4mm in thickness and 47mm from lug-to-lug.
